infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CallMedex needs camera access to scan diagnostic barcodes, upload prescriptions, and conduct telemedicine video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CallMedex needs microphone access to conduct telemedicine consultations with healthcare providers.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: CallMedex uses Face ID to securely authenticate and safeguard your private medical records.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CallMedex requires your location for emergency SOS dispatch and live phlebotomist home sample collection routing.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow CallMedex to use Face ID for fast and secure healthcare access.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CallMedex to access camera for telemedicine and barcode scanning.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow CallMedex to access your location for emergency dispatch and home visits.
